qa_pairs.question: What engine types use the M70/S70/M73/M52 main bearing screws with cast aluminum engine block?
qa_pairs.answer: 2AZ engines with cast aluminum engine block

qa_pairs.question: How does the torque angle differ between M10 and M11 main bearing screws on 2AZ engines?
qa_pairs.answer: M10 main bearing screws require 70° torque angle, while M11 main bearing screws require 100° torque angle
